Product Owner Certification: Mastering the Art of Value Delivery in Scrum

Welcome to the Product Owner Certification, meticulously designed to elevate your understanding and application of the Scrum framework, specifically through the lens of a Product Owner. This assessment-driven course is tailored to affirm your expertise in Scrum practices and the nuances of the Product Owner role, as detailed in the Official Scrum Guide.




For Professionals: Enhance Your Agile Career

As a Product Owner or an individual aspiring to embrace this crucial role within Agile teams, this certification will benchmark your proficiency, enabling you to:

  • Showcase Your Expertise: Demonstrate your comprehensive grasp of the Scrum framework, making you a valuable asset in the Agile job market.

  • Boost Your Career Prospects: Add a significant credential to your resume and LinkedIn profile, opening new doors to career advancement and professional recognition.

For Organizations: Optimize Your Scrum Teams

In today's dynamic landscape of technology and product development, Agile methodologies are the bedrock of successful and timely product delivery. Adopting Scrum can fundamentally transform Agile product management, fostering enhanced collaboration and superior product outcomes. By engaging in our Product Owner Certification Assessment, your organization can reap numerous benefits:

  • Competitive Advantage: Distinguish your company in the realm of Agile product management by showcasing certified Product Owners, appealing to clients and projects that value certified expertise.


The Role of a Product Owner: Champion of Value Maximization

The Product Owner is a key player within Scrum teams, acting as the nexus between the customer, the development team, and the product itself. As a Product Owner, you are charged with:

  • Prioritizing Value Delivery Guide your team in delivering the highest value to customers by effectively managing and ordering the Product Backlog.

  • Facilitating Scrum Artifacts Collaborate with the Scrum Master and development team to ensure that Product Backlog items are well-understood, transparent, and actionable.

  • Navigating Complexity Tackle complex product challenges by fostering an environment that encourages innovation, rapid feedback, and iterative progress.

  • Mentoring and Leadership Empower your team to embrace Agile practices, promoting self-organization, and continuous growth in value delivery.

  • Extensive Scope The assessment encompasses all critical aspects of the Product Owner role, from backlog management to stakeholder engagement, offering a thorough evaluation of your knowledge.

  • Immediate Insights Receive instant feedback on your performance, helping you to identify areas for further study or confirming your expertise.

  • Product Owner Certificate Successful candidates will receive a Product Owner Certificate issued by Agile Enterprise Coach, adding a tangible credential to your professional achievements.

Assessment Structure and Content

The Product Owner Certification Assessment consists of multiple-choice questions that span a wide array of topics, including but not limited to:

  • Scrum Theory and Empiricism

  • Product Owner Responsibilities and Accountabilities

  • Effective Product Backlog Management

  • Maximizing Value and ROI

  • Stakeholder Engagement and Communication

  • Understanding and Applying the Definition of Done


How to Get Certified

  1. Prepare Thoroughly: Study the Official Scrum Guide and familiarize yourself with the role of the Product Owner.

  2. Complete the Assessment: Answer the multiple-choice questions to the best of your ability.

  3. Submit Your Results: Send proof of your completed assessment to receive your Product Owner Certificate from our institution.

  4. Enhance Your Credentials: Display your certification on your CV and professional profiles to showcase your expertise.

234 tools for social recruiting in one course: 121 services and apps shown on screen, 109 ready-to-use search strings, message templates, AI prompts, procedures and checklists, and 4 models and methods.

Open a lecture, copy the search string, run it for your vacancy today.

Why job sites are not enough

The people you most want to hire are not looking for a job. They are not on job sites and do not answer the tenth identical message on LinkedIn. But they are somewhere: a developer keeps code on GitHub, a designer shows work on Behance, a marketer writes on X, and almost everyone has a profile on Facebook or Instagram. Each network is searched in its own way, and most recruiters know only one of them.

What changes after this course

You search each network with the right query and reach profiles outside your contacts. You find developers by their code and designers by their portfolio. You use AI to write job posts and messages and automation to save hours. You find a working contact outside the network. And your own profile makes people answer.

What is inside: 234 tools, counted lecture by lecture

You do not have to take this number on trust. Open any lecture and read its description: every tool inside is listed there by name.

  • 121 services and apps shown on screen, from a quick look to a detailed demo: LinkedIn Sales Navigator, hireEZ, SeekOut, ContactOut, RocketReach, Lusha, Octohunt, GlossaryTech, Humantic AI, Canva and others
  • 109 ready-to-use tools inside the presentations:
  • 46 templates and sample documents, including search string templates and sample messages: LinkedIn X-ray search strings, GitHub X-ray search strings, candidate connection request message, candidate outreach email sequence
  • 27 ready AI prompts: candidate sourcing channels, front-end developer X-ray search, tech recruiter Boolean search, candidate outreach email generation
  • 13 search string sets
  • 9 step-by-step procedures: Facebook hashtag sourcing, four-email candidate outreach sequence, corporate email discovery, username profile discovery
  • 7 checklists: recruiter social profile, LinkedIn connection request, LinkedIn sourcing automation setup, fake LinkedIn profile warning signs
  • 5 question lists and scripts: candidate outreach message sequence, candidate messenger conversation script, recruiting search hypotheses
  • 2 other working tools: Boolean search, GitHub candidate search operators
  • 4 models and methods explained with examples: web scraping, data parsing

More than half of the count are services: this is a course about where and with what to search, with the queries to run there.

Where the tools are

  • Social recruiting core (4 sections, 71 tools). X and Pinterest, Facebook, LinkedIn, Instagram and GitHub, YouTube and TikTok, Telegram.
  • AI recruiting for social media (61 tools). Job posts and visuals, automated search, personalized outreach, profile assessment.

Who is teaching

I am Mike, the #1 HR instructor on Udemy, with 1,800,000+ course enrollments from 170,000 students, and the author of about 200 books on Amazon. I built the people system at Preply as it became a unicorn and worked at Wargaming, iDeals and Alfa-Bank across 20 years in HR. I hold PHRi, SHRM-CP and HCI sHRBP certifications and represent HRCI in Eastern Europe.

courseDetails.title: KI-Agenten in Produktion: Zuverlässige Business-Workflows
courseDetails.shortDescription: Agenten-Workflows entwerfen, evaluieren, überwachen und steuern, die echter geschäftlicher Komplexität standhalten.
courseDetails.longDescription:
Dieser Kurs wurde unter Zuhilfenahme von künstlicher Intelligenz erstellt.

Die meisten Agenten-Kurse bringen Ihnen das Bauen bei. Dieser bringt Ihnen bei, wie man Vertrauen verdient.

Der Markt ist voll von Kursen, die 100 Labs, 100 Agenten in 100 Tagen oder fünf Frameworks an einem Wochenende stapeln. Sie machen Spaß – und in den Bewertungen taucht immer wieder dasselbe auf: „keine Produktionstiefe“. Sie zeigen, wie ein Agent einmal etwas Cleveres tut. Sie zeigen nie, wie er zuverlässig genug wird, um ihn auf ein echtes Unternehmen loszulassen – mit echtem Geld und echten Kunden.

Genau in dieser Lücke lebt dieser Kurs. An einer durchgehenden Fallstudie – Cascade Commerce, ein mittelständischer Händler, dessen spektakuläre Multi-Agenten-Demo in der Produktion zusammenbrach – lernen Sie das Urteilsvermögen für die Produktion, das entscheidet, ob ein Agenten-Workflow live geht oder Sie blamiert:

  • Architekturentscheidungen – einzelner Agent vs. sequenzieller Workflow vs. Router vs. Multi-Agenten vs. Human-in-the-Loop, und wann Sie gar keinen Agenten einsetzen sollten.
  • Geschäftsprozess-Modellierung – beginnen Sie beim Job-to-Be-Done und bilden Sie Inputs, Outputs, Entscheidungen und die Ausnahmen ab, an denen Demos sterben.
  • Kontext & Übergaben – typisierte Schemas und geteilter Zustand, die verhindern, dass Kontext zwischen Agenten verloren geht.
  • Evaluierung – Golden Datasets, Bewertungsraster, Fehlertaxonomien und Regressionstests für den Tag, an dem Sie das Modell wechseln.
  • Observability – Traces, Tool-Aufrufe und Kosten, aufgebaut auf den Ideen von OpenTelemetry, um Schleifen und Drift zu erkennen, bevor Ihre Nutzer es tun.
  • Governance – Tool-Berechtigungen, Freigabe-Gates und Audit-Logs, abgebildet auf das NIST AI RMF und die OWASP Top 10 für LLM-Anwendungen.
  • Pilotstart – Umfang, Erfolgsmetriken, Rollback und Change Management.

Der Kurs ist anbieterneutral – die Architektur altert nicht mit einem bestimmten Framework – und er liefert Vorlagen, die Sie jahrelang wiederverwenden: ein Discovery-Arbeitsblatt, eine Architektur-Entscheidungsmatrix, Rollenkarten, Übergabe-Schemas, ein Bewertungsraster, eine Observability-Checkliste, eine Governance-Kontrollmatrix und eine Checkliste für den Pilotstart. Alle Vorlagen gibt es auf Deutsch.

Sie kommen von „Ich kann eine Agenten-Demo bauen“ zu „Ich kann einen produktionsreifen Agenten-Workflow mit klaren Verantwortlichkeiten, Kontext, Kontrollen und Evaluierung entwerfen.“
